skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.slide.desc: In a fast run, hold Sneak to drop into a slide that keeps your speed.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.long_jump.desc: In a fast run, tap Sneak as you jump to sail out long.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.charge_jump.de: Anyone can charge a jump (stand still, hold Sneak, then hold and let go of Jump). With this, the orange peak on the jump bar sits in the same spot every time.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.strong_swimmer: The swim burst, a push of speed under water, and the breach: from a fast swim, leap clear out of the water.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.shove.desc: The Insert key: shove someone back with an empty hand or a shield, or trip them with a hooked weapon.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.aim_parts.desc: While locked on, scroll to aim at the head, torso, arms or legs. Until then every blow you aim goes at the torso.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.sweep_kick.des: For those with no power: key 2 takes the legs out from under whoever is in front of you.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.boxer.desc: A boxing teacher will take you on: learn the fist styles by their lessons and your own training. A Monk is given the first style with the class.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.haul_bound.des: Lift a hogtied or downed body onto your shoulder, if your brawn beats their armour.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.command.desc: Folk who follow you take your orders: the orders screen and the four quick-order keys.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.two_blades.des: With a blade in each hand, every third swing that lands cuts with both.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.shieldbearer.d: Shield up: sneak and attack to slam, sprint to charge, stand still to brace behind it. Throwing it is the Shield Throw perk.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.thrower.desc: Throw what you hold: a sword end over end, daggers, hatchets and spears, throwing weapons, and the throwables on your belt (by hand or on the belt keys).
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.shield_vault.d: Jump, then Dodge in the air in front of a foe holding up a shield, to go over them and land behind.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.swat.desc: A perfect parry with a blade knocks an arrow back at the archer.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.horseman.desc: Rank 1: the horse whistle (hold N to whistle and pick a command). Rank 2: horse tricks (the trick key, and hold Back to kick). A Rider knows both from the start.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.skyfarer.desc: Rank 1: fly a paraglider. Rank 2: work a hot air balloon's burner.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.read_scrolls.d: Read a spell scroll to cast it. A Mage needs no lesson in this.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.sorcery.desc: Hold J looking at your element to draw it into your reserve, and hold it empty-handed to throw the reserve as a barrage. Opens your element's own workings too: the Storm Ring, Bulwark, Tide Pearl or Harrying Gale (sneak and hold J), Bolt Step, and death's and blood's keys.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.forbidden_arts: The forbidden elements, Death and Blood: raising thralls, reaping, blood grips. Needs Sorcery.
Opens the class paths: pick your class's path in the Growth screen. Any pillar's Path perk will do.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.second_surviva: Opens a second class: a master of a class (a villager at the top of its trade) will teach it to you for silver. Any pillar's will do. Needs this pillar's Path perk.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.path_stealth.d: Opens the class paths: pick your class's path in the Growth screen. Any pillar's Path perk will do.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.second_stealth: Opens a second class: a master of a class (a villager at the top of its trade) will teach it to you for silver. Any pillar's will do. Needs this pillar's Path perk.
Opens the class paths: pick your class's path in the Growth screen. Any pillar's Path perk will do.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.second_strengt: Opens a second class: a master of a class (a villager at the top of its trade) will teach it to you for silver. Any pillar's will do. Needs this pillar's Path perk.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.smith.desc: Work the forge hearth, the bellows and the stone, field and smithing anvils, and make them. The iron Smithing Anvil still needs Knowledge 1.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.brewer.desc: Ferment ale, cider, mead and wine in casks and distil spirits in a still, and make them.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.sawyer.desc: Cut layer blocks and timber trim with a saw.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.angler.desc: Real fishing: casting a proper rod (a plain rod still fishes the plain way), the fishing journal, and selling your catch to a fisherman by weight.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.alchemist.desc: The crucible, the alembics and the infusion matrix, making them, and reading the codex.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.smelter.desc: The melter, the smeltery, the foundry and the alloyer, with their channels, faucets, drains and tanks, and the casting tables and basins. Making them too.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.millwright.des: Windmills, waterwheels, gearboxes, the grindstone, the presses, the chopper and the machine parts, and making them.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.gemcutter.desc: The lapidary wheel and the jeweller's bench, and making them.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.whaler.desc: Throw a harpoon at the great whales and boil their blubber at the tryworks.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.rigwright.desc: Salvage a fallen rig and build a rig suit at the Rig Forge, and make the forge.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.blood_awakenin: Wakes your blood's own moves: its heritage-key move and its held move. The gifts it was born with, that need no key, are yours anyway.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.lifeleech.desc: Your kills lend you extra hearts.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.night_sense.de: You always know the way to your own kind: a vampire's kin sense, a wolf's pack sense.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.night_pound.de: The P key: a vampire's Groundpound, a werewolf's Howl. Both show you the people behind the walls.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.bat_wings.desc: A vampire's wings: press Jump in the air to glide.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.skills.blood.none: Your blood has no move of its own to wake.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.growth.path_locked: A class path is learned first: a Path perk in the skill tree (any pillar, level 10).
message.jaymoskingdoms.tree_lock.locked: You haven't learned that yet: %s (skill tree, K)
message.jaymoskingdoms.tree_lock.rank: You haven't learned that yet: %s, rank %s (skill tree, K)
message.jaymoskingdoms.tree_lock.path: You haven't learned to walk a path yet: a Path perk (skill tree, K)
talk.jaymoskingdoms.tree_lock.remark.0: Nobody's born knowing that. I had to learn it too.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.tree_lock.remark.1: Took me a whole summer to get that right. Keep at it.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.tree_lock.remark.2: Ha! I looked just like that, before my mother taught me.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.tree_lock.remark.3: You'll get it. Everyone has to learn it some time.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.tree_lock.remark.4: Not like that. Somebody has to show you. Somebody showed me.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.tree_lock.remark.5: Didn't anyone teach you? Someone taught all of us.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.tree_lock.remark.6: My father used to say nobody comes into the world able to do anything. He was right.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.tree_lock.remark.7: Learn it first, friend. We all did.
boxing.jaymoskingdoms.untaught.0: You hit like someone who has never been shown, %1$s. Learn what a fist is for first (Boxer, in the skill tree), then come back.
boxing.jaymoskingdoms.untaught.1: Not yet. Your feet don't know where to go. Find that in yourself first (Boxer), and I'll teach you the rest.
boxing.jaymoskingdoms.untaught.2: I don't start with nothing, %1$s. Learn to box at all (Boxer), and then we'll talk about my way.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.188: Nobody is born able to slide, pick a pocket or work a forge. When something won't work, the action bar names the skill tree perk that teaches it (K).
